title: Folate metabolism modifies chromosomal damage induced by 1,3-butadiene: results from a match-up study in China and in vitro experiments
reasoning: The abstract discusses the role of 5-methyltetrahydrofolate (5-MTHF) in modifying chromosomal damage induced by 1,3-Butadiene (BD) and its metabolite, indicating that 5-MTHF supplementation could mitigate the harmful effects associated with BD exposure. This suggests that 5-MTHF may serve as a safer alternative by reducing the genotoxic effects of BD.

target_chemical_harm.rationale: The reasoning explicitly states that 1,3-Butadiene (BD) exposure is associated with genotoxicity, including chromosomal damage such as increased frequencies of micronucleus, nucleoplasmic bridge, and nuclear bud.
